title: PPLPPL
author: Akmal Hakim Danial M.
desc: The PPLPPL program is a 6-day split designed to build muscle through targeted workouts. Each session lasts 180 minutes, focusing on major muscle groups with compound and isolation exercises. You'll engage in a variety of movements, including incline bench presses and machine-based training, to maximize strength gains. Perfect for both beginners and intermediates looking to enhance their physique and performance.
